example: Example run with fictional figures: Northbrook Trading, a batch of supplier bills in two PDFs, Monday 12 October 2026. The figures match the worked examples on the step-by-step page.

messages.text: A pile of supplier bills came in. Can you read them and check them before we pay?
Yes. Before I read anything, I need five answers. I ask them all at once, so the run does not stop again for each one.
list: Do you want me to use MosoFin, or will you upload the data?
Please attach the bills: PDF, PNG, JPG or a scan of many pages.
Which output do you want: Excel, CSV or JSON?
Is any document in the batch not a bill, for example a receipt, a statement or a quote?

messages.text: Use MosoFin. Both PDFs are attached. They are all for Northbrook Trading. Excel is fine. I think there is a statement in there.

messages.label: Checked the workspace and the company file
messages.summary: The agent can read your books. It cannot change them.

messages.text: I found 13 documents in your two PDFs. The last two pages of bills_b.pdf are a Harbor Office Supply statement, which is usually not posted.
messages.after: Here is my plan. I extract **12 documents** for **Northbrook Trading**. I check each one against your supplier list and your posted bills, **paid and open, for the last 12 months**. Output as Excel. Shall I set the statement aside and go ahead?

messages.label: Read the books in one batch
messages.summary: 7 reads in one batch. Nothing in your books changed.

messages.text: **Stop** on Crestline Logistics INV-7731 for **$4,860.00**. It is a "Reminder" copy of a bill that is already in your books and paid:
messages.after: A list of unpaid bills does not show this match. I hold the $4,860.00 from payment. The bill was also paid twice already. That needs a separate look. Here I only stop the third copy.

messages.text: **Stop** on Keystone KS-1140 for **$350.00**. The bill is for **Northbrook Holdings LLC**, and no connected company has that name. I do not send it to the nearest match. Please tell me which company it belongs to.
Five bills need a person to look at them before payment:

card.title: Review
head: Bill
Total
Why
rows: Pays to a PO box. Your supplier record shows a different address
September work, with an October date
The bill says Net 30. Your record says 2/10 Net 30
New supplier. "$" only, and 03/10/2026 has two readings

messages.after: For Lakeside, call the phone number that you already have on file. Do not use a number from the bill. My bank-detail check is **NOT RUN**, because I cannot read bank details.

messages.text: I write null for what I cannot see. Maple Ridge's currency and date are null until you tell me. I do not take "$" to mean US dollars.
messages.after: Metro Shred's MS-2209 does not add up. Its line and tax come to $129.90, but the printed total is $139.90. I record the figures as printed and flag the 10 dollars. Oakfield's PF-0007 is a pro forma, a quote for a sign, so I leave it out.

messages.text: Here is the batch in US dollars:
messages.after: The count is 4 Clean + 5 Review + 2 Stop + 1 Excluded = 12. Maple Ridge is not in the total, because its currency is unknown. I post nothing and pay nothing.

messages.text: Here is **Invoices_Extracted_2026-10-12_12invoices.xlsx**. It has the Invoices, Line Items, Tax Detail, Source Reference, Validation Results and Coverage sheets. Every figure points to its file and page.
messages.after: I can also compare the Harbor statement with your payables balance. And do you want me to save your settings for the next batch?

messages.text: Save the settings. The statement can wait.
Done. I saved the Bill-To name for Northbrook Trading, the 12-month look-back and the status rules. I never save bill contents, amounts or bank details.
